title: Garage Door Warranty Request Form
subtitle: Control inspection, stored-energy control, repair, balance, safety testing, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete garage door service warranty request for doors, tracks, springs, cables, operators, controls, and safety devices. It connects manufacturer information and approved safety scope to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a garage-door service coordinator must investigate a garage door service warranty or callback without treating the request as a coverage decision before identity, chronology, condition, and evidence are reviewed.

sections.title: Garage Door interim control and preservation
sections.guidance: Protect people, property, evidence, and the claimed item while preserving the distinction between temporary help and a final remedy.

blocks.label: Interim control and preservation options
items: Door, operator, remotes, and controls isolated against unexpected movement
Torsion, extension, counterbalance, and suspended-door energy controlled
People, pets, vehicles, and property cleared from the door path
Door weight supported before spring, cable, roller, track, or bracket work
Ladder, lift, tool, winding-bar, and access method appropriate and inspected
Structural attachments, header, track supports, and fasteners assessed
Photoelectric, edge, force, reversal, release, and control functions preserved
Replacement spring, cable, roller, hardware, and operator compatibility verified
Customer remotes and access features controlled during testing
Full balance and entrapment-protection test plan completed before release

sections.title: Garage Door warranty exception and escalation
sections.guidance: Route unsafe, disputed, missing-evidence, third-party, or out-of-scope conditions without implying a coverage outcome.

blocks.label: Garage Door exception and stop-work indicators
items: Door, spring, cable, fixture, or counterbalance energy not controlled
Door cannot be independently supported during work
Track, header, bracket, ceiling, or structural attachment is damaged or uncertain
Cable fray, spring crack, bottom-fixture damage, or uncontrolled movement observed
Photoelectric, edge, force, reversal, or emergency-release protection fails
Door is unbalanced, binds, drifts, falls, or requires excessive manual force
Operator, wiring, grounding, control, or power condition is unsafe
People, pets, vehicles, or property cannot be kept clear of the travel path
Replacement component compatibility or manufacturer procedure is uncertain
Customer requests bypass, disabling, or release without required safety protection
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Exception containment, decision, and escalation register

sections.title: Garage Door warranty request closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This garage door service warranty request is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when spring, cable, door support, operator, entrapment protection, balance, structural attachment, electrical, or controlled-energy condition is uncertain. A garage-door safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
